title: Easy Grilled Argentinian Seafood Skewers
description: A low-sodium Argentinian dish featuring a frozen seafood mix, char-grilled to perfection with a mustardy and silky flavor, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, approximately 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, garlic powder, paprika, and salt-free seasoning blend.
Add the thawed seafood mix to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated seafood mix onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the seafood is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and serve immediately.
Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for future meals.
